source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB setter paired with next getter; event injection/delivery is separate coverage.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x04/0x00 with undefined request data; clear logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; operator bytes; warns routing change.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly requires bytes but does not define receiver encoding, disable sentinel, delivery or restore.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires approved receiver address/LUN, reachability, optional safe delivery and restore.
historical_reviews.history: Getter alone proves configuration, not delivery.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Alert-routing write needs explicit owner approval and preserved evidence.

original_test_intent: Set one approved platform-event receiver, confirm configuration and optionally prove safe end-to-end delivery, then restore prior routing.
original_method: Send Sensor/Event 0x04/0x00 with target-specific receiver request bytes.
manual_activity: Monitoring owner approves the receiver identity, routing window, safe stimulus if any and restoration.
safety_requirements: Do not use 0xFF unless explicitly testing disable
agent_execution_scope: Optionally observe separately approved harmless event

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Operator placeholder preserves uncertainty but is not executable evidence and lacks sentinel/recovery controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected 0x04/0x00 with validated receiver address/LUN, immediately read back, prove allowed delivery if scoped, then restore.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat routing change, readback, delivery and restoration as distinct checkpoints.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines receiver identity and recovery without guessing request bytes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command completion/readback does not prove events reach the receiver.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong or disabled routing can silently lose or leak platform alerts.

project_override_considerations: A vendor/Redfish routing API is equivalent only with the same destination, readback, delivery and restore coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and command family align; missing request data is a Project readiness gap, not a semantic contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core operation is clear; receiver bytes and authorization are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Adds explicit destination, disable guard, end-to-end distinction and restoration to an otherwise unsafe placeholder write.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful Set Event Receiver response proves only that the BMC accepted bytes; it does not prove the receiver is reachable or that a platform event is delivered. The prior receiver must be captured first because a bad or 0xFF value may suppress monitoring and cannot be repaired from command completion alone.
